payload.name: Environment Variable Registry and Runtime Drift
payload.description: Reading HOLON_* environment variables directly in runtime, entrypoint, or build code without updating the typed registry (sandbox_executor/env_registry.py, sandbox_executor/config_env_keys.py) and docs/environment_variables.md causes undocumented knobs, silent default mismatches, and broken container passthrough.
symptoms: Two-way AST/text drift test failures in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_environment_reference.py
Environment variables accepted on the host but silently dropped when launching sandbox containers
Stale or missing HOLON_* entries in docs/environment_variables.md
root_causes: Ad-hoc os.environ.get('HOLON_...') lookups added outside sandbox_executor/env_registry.py and sandbox_executor/config_env_keys.py
Removing or renaming runtime variables without pruning the registry and documentation in the same change
Duplicating default values across host configuration and container entrypoint scripts

mitigations.description: Declare every HOLON_* key once in sandbox_executor/env_registry.py and sandbox_executor/config_env_keys.py and document it in docs/environment_variables.md.

mitigations.strategy: Two-way AST and doc drift verification
mitigations.description: Run apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_environment_reference.py to verify that every referenced HOLON_* key is registered and documented and that no orphaned entries remain.
